DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: メールアドレスの変更をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to change your email address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: メールが来ないので、新しいものに変えたいです。今のアドレスが間違っていると思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未着でアドレス誤りと思い変更したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am not receiving emails, so I want to change to a new one. I think the current address is wrong.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that missing emails make you think the address is wrong and you want to change it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 登録の表記と、受信の設定を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the registered spelling separately from the receiving settings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 登録は合っています。他のメールは届きますが、銀行からの案内だけ見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表記一致で他メールは受信できると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The registration is correct. Other emails arrive, but I cannot find the bank’s messages.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the spelling matches and you can receive other emails. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通知の対象や現在の状態を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check which notifications apply and the current status.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。アドレスを変えれば必ず直ると思わず、今の設定を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 変更で解消保証と思わず現設定の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I want to understand the current settings, rather than assume changing the address will definitely fix it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check the current settings without assuming a change guarantees a solution. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 最近、ご自身で変更した設定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you recently changed any settings yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内メールを止める項目を選びました。ただ、必要な連絡も全部止まったかはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内停止操作と影響範囲未確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I selected an option to stop informational emails. But I do not know whether that also stopped all necessary messages.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you stopped informational emails but have not confirmed the extent of the effect. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 設定の範囲を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check with the person in charge what the setting covers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。必要な連絡と案内メールを分けて確認し、希望する受取方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要連絡と案内の設定を分け受取方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I want to check necessary messages separately from informational emails and discuss how I would like to receive them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check settings for necessary messages and informational emails separately and discuss delivery methods. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。登録アドレスと通知設定を調べてから、変更が必要な項目をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will check the registered address and notification settings before explaining what needs changing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お菓子を配るためにお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for snacks to give out?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、六人に渡します。この六枚入りなら、一人ずつ未開封のまま渡せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 六人へ未開封で渡すため六枚入りが合うか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, for six people. If this has six pieces, can I give each person one unopened package?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a six-piece pack is suitable for giving six people unopened portions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この教材の商品は二枚ずつ一袋で、三袋入りです。枚数と包装の数は違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The product in this exercise has three bags, each containing two pieces. The number of pieces differs from the number of packages.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 六枚なら六袋だと思っていました。これでは未開封の袋は三人分ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二枚ずつ三袋で六包装ではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought six pieces meant six bags. This only gives unopened bags for three people.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that it has three bags of two pieces, not six separate packages. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋を開けて一枚ずつ分ける方法もありますが、未開封で渡したいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You could open the bags and divide the pieces, but you want to give them unopened, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、自分で包み直すのではなく、元の包装のまま六人へ渡せるものを選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分で包み直さず六つの元包装を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Rather than rewrap them myself, I want something I can give six people in its original packaging.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for six original packages without rewrapping them yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらは一枚ずつの袋が六つ入る箱です。外箱の表示も確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This box has six bags with one piece in each. You can also check the outer-box labeling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それが希望に合います。枚数だけでなく六袋あることを表示で確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別商品の六袋表示を確認して希望と照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: That suits what I want. I will check that the label says six bags, not just the piece count.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the other product’s six-bag labeling against your needs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この箱は四百円です。保存方法と期限も外箱をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: This box is 400 yen. Please also check the storage instructions and date on the outer box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予算内です。六袋の表示と保存方法を確認できたので、この箱にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 価格と保存条件確認後に六袋の箱を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is within my budget. I have checked the six-bag label and storage instructions, so I will take this box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the six-bag box after checking the price and storage conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。六つの未開封の袋が入る商品として、こちらの箱を会計へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please take this box to the checkout as the product containing six unopened bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 道の確認をされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check the way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、電話で話しながら歩いて、分岐を通り過ぎました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通話歩行で分岐を過ぎたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I was walking while talking on the phone and passed the junction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you passed the junction while walking on the phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず周りの通行を妨げない場所で止まりましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, let us stop somewhere that does not block other people.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: わかりました。このまま電話を見て戻らず、広い場所へ移ってから確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画面を見て戻らず広い場所で止まると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I will move to a spacious place and check, rather than walk back while looking at my phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will stop in a spacious area instead of returning while looking at the screen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 電話を続ける必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you need to continue the call?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族と話しています。いったん止まり、現在地を確かめてから話を終えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族通話を止め現在地確認後に終えると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am talking with my family. I will stop for now, check my location, then end the call.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will pause the family call, check your location and then end it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内板で位置を確認できます。どこへ戻りたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can locate yourself on the information board. Where do you want to return?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口です。電話の相手が思う場所ではなく、今見える案内板を基準に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手推測でなく現案内板で入口への道を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The entrance. Please use the board I can see now, not where the person on the phone thinks I am.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the entrance route using the current board rather than the caller’s guess. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口までの通路をお示しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will show you the passage to the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。歩き出す前に電話をしまい、足元と途中の表示を見て戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 出発前に電話をしまい足元と表示を見ると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Before walking, I will put my phone away and watch my footing and signs along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will put away the phone before setting off and watch the ground and signs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。通行できる経路を確認し、周囲に気を付けてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13229-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Check that the route is accessible and proceed carefully, paying attention to your surroundings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物が重いのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your luggage is heavy, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。駅の中で台車を借りられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 台車借用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Can I borrow a trolley inside the station?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to borrow a trolley. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 利用できる範囲を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check where it may be used.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ホームまで自由に持ち出すとは決めず、返す場所も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 利用範囲と返却を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will not assume I can take it freely onto the platform. I also want to ask where to return it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about the permitted area and return location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 移動先はどちらですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 北口です。列車には乗りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乗車なしの移動先を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The north exit. I will not be taking a train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give your destination and say that you are not boarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 係員が運搬方法を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: A staff member will explain how to move the luggage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一人なので、荷物を残して台車だけ取りに行く方法は避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物を残さない方法を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am alone, so I would like to avoid leaving my luggage to fetch just the trolley.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a method that does not leave the luggage unattended. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この場所で担当を呼びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will call the person in charge to this spot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 待ちます。自分の荷物と北口までの移動として相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: その場で荷物を管理して待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait. I am asking about taking my own luggage to the north exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait on the spot while looking after your luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 荷物はここで管理してください。担当が台車の条件と北口への運搬方法を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep your luggage under your care here. The person in charge will explain trolley conditions and how to move it to the north exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引越していません。住所の表記が変わる通知をもらいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 引越しなしの表示変更を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have not moved. I received a notice that the written form of my address is changing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the address designation is changing without a move. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知を見せてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 旧表示と新表示があります。転入した日を書こうとして迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧新表示を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It has the old and new versions. I was unsure what to write for the move-in date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the old and new address designations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ家で暮らしていることを先に伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同じ居住場所を明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please tell them first that I still live in the same house.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Make clear that your residence has not changed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本人の情報も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check your personal details too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 身分の書類はこちらです。通知の日付を移動日とは扱いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通知日と転居日を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here is my identification. I will not treat the notice date as a moving date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the notice date from a moving date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 関係先への連絡も相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can also ask about notifying relevant organizations.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 銀行などへ何を示すか、住所変更の案内を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 関係先向け資料を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would like guidance on the address change, including what to show the bank and other places.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the documents needed for relevant organizations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 居住場所は変わらない住所表示の相談として担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass this on as an address-designation inquiry with no change in residence.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to change your appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 電話で変えた後、私の予定表に古い日が残っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 変更後の古い予定表を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: After changing it by phone, I found the old date still in my calendar.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your calendar still shows the old date after a change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 前の連絡日はいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: When did you contact us previously?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日です。新しい希望を出す前に登録日時を調べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前の連絡時点を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yesterday. Before I request another change, please check the registered date and time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the date of the previous contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予約番号はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have the reservation number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。自分の予定表だけで旧予約が残るとは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号で現予約を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. I will not assume the old appointment remains just because it is in my own calendar.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Use the number to compare the current appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今の登録は金曜の三時です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The current booking is Friday at three.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話の返事と同じです。元の火曜の予定を自分の表から消します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人予定表を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: That matches what I was told on the phone. I will remove the original Tuesday entry from my calendar.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Correct your personal calendar. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今回は変更しませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: So you are not making a change this time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、金曜三時を保ちます。受付時刻も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約維持と受付確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Correct. I will keep Friday at three. I also want to check the reception time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to keep the appointment and check reception details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 予約変更はせず、金曜三時の受付案内をお渡しします。ご自身の予定表も合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Without changing the booking, I will give you reception instructions for Friday at three. Please update your own calendar to match.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見当たりませんか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 車体はあります。前輪だけ無くなっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車体と前輪の状態を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The frame is there. Only the front wheel is gone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Distinguish the state of the frame from the front wheel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所と気付いた時刻は。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where is it, and when did you notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅前です。今朝七時に気付きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発見場所と時刻を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Outside the station. I noticed at seven this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the discovery location and time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最後に全体を見たのは。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: When did you last see the whole bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨夜八時です。誰が外したかは見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最終確認と目撃なしを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: At eight last night. I did not see who removed the wheel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the last confirmed time and say you did not witness the removal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 修理に出されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you sent it for repair?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いえ。家族にも確認しますが、車体をそのまま残し写真を撮りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 修理未依頼と保存状態を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I will ask my family too, but I left the frame where it was and took photos.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you did not arrange repairs and explain how you preserved the situation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 特徴と登録を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will ask about its features and registration.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この番号です。自転車全体の紛失ではなく、前輪の状況を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号で部品不在を届ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: This is the number. I am reporting the front wheel’s condition, not the loss of the whole bicycle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report the missing part using the registration number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 車体が残る場所、時刻、前輪の不在を記録します。現物の扱いは担当の案内を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will record the frame’s location, the times and the missing front wheel. Follow the person in charge’s guidance on handling the bicycle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this a check before sending?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 番号が一、二、四です。三頁が抜けたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 頁欠落の可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The numbers are one, two and four. Page three may be missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Mention a possible missing page. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先の一覧はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the recipient’s checklist?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あります。白紙だから不要かも自分では分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一覧と必要性不明を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I cannot tell myself whether it is blank and unnecessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the checklist and say you do not know whether the page is required. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要頁は提出先へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the required pages with the recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三頁を自分で作らず、元の書類を家で調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己作成せず原資料を調べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will check the original documents at home instead of making page three myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the originals instead of creating the page yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日はまだ差し出しませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you hold off sending it today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、封も閉じません。控えの頁数も見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未発送で控えも確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, and I will not seal it. I will review the page count in my copy too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say it remains unsent and you will check your copy too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 揃った後に発送方法を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain shipping methods once everything is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 必要頁と宛先を確認してから、この書類一件として持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要頁確認後の発送を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will confirm the required pages and address, then bring these documents as one submission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will send after confirming the required pages. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今日は発送を保留します。必要頁の確認と配送の相談を分けてご準備ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will hold off shipping today. Please prepare by checking the required pages separately from discussing delivery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 開設の申し込みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this an application to open an account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 途中で保存しました。新しく作らず続きから確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 保存申込の再開を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saved it partway through. Can we check and resume it instead of starting a new one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to resume the saved application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 完了の通知はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a completion notification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありません。保存を受付済みとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 完了未通知を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I do not think saving means the application was accepted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that no completion notification has arrived. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本人の画面を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check your own screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: パスワードは読み上げず、自分で必要な画面を開きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人操作で認証情報を保つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will open the required screen myself without reading my password aloud.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Operate it yourself while protecting your login information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 住所に変更はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入力後に部屋番号が分かりました。送る前に正しく直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未送信住所を訂正したいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I learned the apartment number after entering the information. I want to correct it before sending.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to correct the unsent address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 再開方法を担当が案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will explain how to resume.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 保存分の状態を確認し、重複申込を作らず見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 重複申込を避け確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the saved application’s status and review it without creating a duplicate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check while avoiding a duplicate application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 未送信の保存申込として確認します。本人操作で住所を見直してから進めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check it as an unsent saved application. Review the address yourself before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check the weight?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: りんごと梨を一袋に入れました。別の価格ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 混合した異価格商品を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put apples and pears into one bag. They have different prices, I see.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Declare that you mixed products with different prices. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 安い方の値札を全部に使わず、二種類の量を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 種類別計量を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to see the amount of each type, rather than use the cheaper price label for all of them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for separate weighing by type. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な数はそれぞれいくつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: How many of each do you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二個ずつです。計量後の金額で減らすか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要数と価格後の選択を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two each. I will decide whether to reduce the quantity after seeing the weighed price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the quantities and say you will decide after checking the price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで二袋にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will separate them into two bags here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。貼るラベルも各袋に対応させます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ラベルを袋へ対応させる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I will make sure each label goes with the correct bag too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Match each label to its bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二袋の合計はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is the total for the two bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予算内です。この四個を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合計確認後に購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is within my budget. I will take these four pieces of fruit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Make the purchase after checking the total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 種類別の二袋と各ラベルでお持ちください。確認した合計で会計できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14150-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the two bags separated by type with their labels. You can pay the confirmed total at checkout.
